A segment of semilength n staying strictly above (or strictly below) the diagonal is counted by the Catalan number C_{n-1}, so each segment contributes 2*C_{n-1}. Total = 2^4 * sum over compositions of 10 into 4 parts of prod C_{ni-1} = 16 * [x^10](x C(x))^4 = 16 * [x^6] C(x)^4, where C(x) is the Catalan generating function. Using [x^n] C(x)^k = k/(2n+k) * binom(2n+k, n): [x^6]C^4 = 4/16 * binom(16,6) = 8008/4 = 2002. Hence total = 16 * 2002 = 32032. (Check of formula: [x^6]C^1 = 1/13*binom(13,6)=132=C_6.)
